Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing ONE issue in the Email OS Vue/Tauri client (repo = your worktree). Read first: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md (esp. dates/label rules, reader notes), src/components/ReaderView.vue, src/lib/browsing-dates.ts, src/assets/style.css (reader/message sections), and how InboxList.vue renders row date + snippet-like text.

## Shared rules (all reader-review tasks)
- Context: we compared our conversation reader against a Superhuman screenshot. Superhuman shows each collapsed earlier message as ONE line: sender | snippet of the body | short date right-aligned. Ours shows only sender + a long full date ("Thu 9 Jan 2025, 7:43 PM") so collapsed messages can't be scanned.
- Stay on-brand per PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md: terse, honest-state, keyboard-first, no AI/sparkle features, no Superhuman scope import. Message content must stay text-interpolated only (no v-html).
- Keep every existing `data-test` attribute, aria-label and keyboard behaviour working unless your issue explicitly changes it; update existing tests in tests/ (and src tests) that your change legitimately affects. Do NOT edit DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md — put design-doc notes in your final report.
- Other agents are changing the same files in parallel on separate branches (issues: toolbar→header, body type/measure, Details/focus-ring dedupe, star status line, active-card style, recent-mail filter). Keep your diff MINIMAL and localized; do not refactor or reformat unrelated code.
- Setup: run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (full suite; report pass/fail honestly, including pre-existing failures).
- Preview: `pnpm dev --port <PORT> --strictPort` (in-memory fixture workspace). Open with mcp__t3-code__preview_* tools (load via ToolSearch), resize to 1280x800, press Enter on the focused first row to open "Fixture thread 1: weekly status" (3 messages). Stop your dev server and close your preview tab when done.
- Evidence: save PNGs under the evidence dir below (mkdir -p). Capture BEFORE (base commit, before editing) and AFTER at 1280x800 via preview_snapshot save=true (copy screenshotPath into your evidence dir with names like before-reader.png / after-reader.png). If blurry, retry, and add getBoundingClientRect geometry in the report.
- Commit on your worktree's branch (no push, no PR). End the commit message with: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Final report (brief): branch + head SHA, files changed, what you did, tests run/results, evidence absolute paths, DESIGN.md notes, anything you couldn't do.

## Your issue: P1 – Collapsed messages don't support scanning
- In the collapsed state of `.message-toggle`, show: sender (existing), a one-line truncated snippet of the message body (single line, ellipsis, plain text derived from `message.bodyText` with whitespace collapsed, ~first 140 chars; text interpolation only; if body empty/unavailable show nothing rather than inventing text), and a short right-aligned date using the existing row-date format helpers in browsing-dates.ts (the compact form like "8 OCT" / time-of-day rules per DESIGN.md "Label"/dates section; reuse `rowDateLabel`-style helper, don't write a second formatter). Keep `<time datetime>` and put the full date label in the element `title` and keep it fully available in the details disclosure and to screen readers (accessible name must still include the full date).
- Expanded message header: keep sender + "to …" and show the same short date right-aligned (full date in title/details). The expanded body must not repeat the snippet.
- Layout: single 24-28px line per collapsed message; date column right-aligned with tabular numerals; snippet uses `min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap` in the flex row; no wrapping at 1030px width.
- The collapsed row must keep the `message-toggle-<id>` test id, aria-expanded, and remain a single focusable control.
- Add/adjust tests for snippet derivation (whitespace collapsing, truncation, empty body) next to existing reader tests.
- Evidence dir: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p1-snippets . PORT: 5202. Required: before/after at 1280x800 showing the collapsed rows; an after shot at 1030x800; an after shot with a long-body message (if fixtures lack one, temporarily tweak the fixture in a scratch edit, screenshot, and revert).

This is the only large text in the shell. - **Title** (600, 0.75rem / 12px, 1.35): sender names, contact email, section labels ("Mail"), footer labels, notice labels. - **Body** (400, 0.75rem / 12px, 1.35): subject (Paper White), snippet and threads (Ash), date-group captions (Ash). - **Label** (400, 0.75rem / 12px, tabular numerals): dates ("8:00 AM", "6 NOV" with an uppercase month) and counts in status text. - **Mono** and the other steps are CSS tokens: `--type-headline`, `--type-body`, `--type-count`, `--type-mono`, `--weight-regular`, `--weight-strong` (`src/assets/style.css`). Use the tokens, never a literal size. ### Dates Row and reader dates are one fixed product format, not a locale format. They depend only on the instant, the current time and the viewer's time zone (`src/lib/browsing-dates.ts`). Month group captions ("October 2026") still follow the locale. - **Row, today:** the time, 12-hour, no leading zero: "8:00 AM", "12:05 PM". - **Row, earlier this calendar year:** day and month: "6 NOV". The DOM text is "6 Nov"; CSS uppercases it, so screen readers hear a word, not letters. - **Row, any other year (past or future):** day, month and four-digit year: "9 JAN 2025". The day is kept for precision, and a two-digit year would read as another day. - **Unknown or unparsable:** "Unknown" in the row, "Unknown date" in full form. Never blank. - **Full form** (reader message times, the row date's hover title): "Thu 9 Jan 2025, 6:29 PM". The same 12-hour clock as the row. - Every rendered date is a `` with a normalized ISO `datetime` when the timestamp parses. - **Count** (400, 0.6875rem / 11px): split-tab counts, set 4px after the tab label. - **Mono** (400, 0.85rem, 1.45): the current plain-text message body in the reader. content.text:
Collapsed reader messages now show sender, a one-line snippet and a short right-aligned date. It's committed on `t3/a45e10b8` at `08e14ea`, with no push or PR. The dev server is stopped and the preview tab is closed.

**What changed**
- **Collapsed row:** sender in a 132px column, then the snippet, then the date.
  - The snippet comes from `message.bodyText` with whitespace collapsed, cut at 140 characters with `…`. It's text-interpolated only, and an empty body shows no snippet at all.
  - The date comes from the existing `compactDateLabel`, so no second formatter. CSS uppercases it ("9 JAN 2025"), with tabular numerals.
  - The row is a single 24px line. The snippet clips with an ellipsis instead of wrapping.
- **Expanded header:** sender and "to …" stay, with the same short date on the right, and the snippet is not repeated.
- **Full date:** it's in the time element's `title`, in a visually hidden span so the accessible name still includes it, and in the Details "Sent" field.
- **Unchanged:** `message-toggle-<id>`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, the roving tabindex and the single focusable control all work as before.
- **Details link:** it still shows under collapsed messages, so a collapsed message is still visually two lines. That is existing behaviour, and the Details dedupe agent's issue should handle it.

**Files:** `src/components/ReaderView.vue`, `src/assets/style.css`, new `src/lib/message-snippet.ts`, new `tests/message-snippet.test.ts` and `tests/reader.component.test.ts`.

**Tests:** `pnpm typecheck` is clean.
- **Added:** four snippet tests covering whitespace collapse, truncation at 140 characters, empty and null bodies, and literal markup. One reader component test covers the collapsed and expanded states, the date title and `datetime`, the accessible-name text, and the empty-body case.
- **Full suite:** the last full run passed (705 passed, 32 skipped).
- **Flaky under load:** two earlier runs failed. One had a single failure in `discovery.component.test.ts`, which also failed on the base commit when run alone under load. The other had 14 failures across 8 files, which I put down to my dev server and preview tab running at the same time. I didn't capture which tests failed in that run, and it didn't reproduce on a clean rerun.

**Evidence** (all in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p1-snippets/`):
- `before-reader.png` and `after-reader.png`, both at 1280x800.
- `after-reader-1030.png`.
- `after-reader-long-body-1030.png`, taken with a temporary long-body fixture edit that I reverted.
- **Geometry:** the toggle height is 24px in every state. At 1280px the snippet is 701px wide with the date right-aligned at the button edge. At 1030px, with the long body, the snippet is clipped, the date column is intact and there is no horizontal scroll.

**DESIGN.md notes** (I didn't edit it):
- Reader dates: collapsed and expanded message headers now use the compact row date ("9 JAN 2025", or the time if the message is from today), with the full form in `title`, screen-reader text and Details. This replaces the earlier "reader message times are full dates" wording in item 14 and the Dates section.
- New reader row spec:
  - **Row height:** 24px.
  - **Sender column:** 132px, collapsed only.
  - **Snippet:** Body type in Ash, one line, the first 140 characters, with an ellipsis.
  - **Date:** right-aligned Label.
  - **Empty body:** no snippet is shown.
- Item 16's "reader view not shown" is still true. This follows the Superhuman reader screenshot.
